does: The spell cast system's application of interrupts to a cast's rolls: for every target's SpellRollData (0x1B8 each) whose ConditionRolls hold exactly one roll with RollAdjustments (looked up by the roll's Guid at ConditionRoll+0x120) it calls esv::interrupt::AdjustConditionRoll and rewrites the hit flags at +0x34: success flipped (bit 0; attack also 0x100, save 0x6), critical 0x8, advantage 0x2000, disadvantage 0x4000. A SpellRollData of more than one roll ends the pass.

evidence.says: its only caller is a function of the spell cast system's update (0x3357380, from 0x334EFA0); pairs with the Toolkit's FUN_1811d9000 that calls AdjustConditionRoll

called once per used interrupt on an attack (CriticalExecution, a SetRoll(1) interrupt, Lucky) and on a Sacred Flame save (Bardic Inspiration), 0.43 s after the roll event, in the same tick as the combat log's Interrupt entry
